statement:
∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ r : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall z₀ ρ) →
      (∀ z ∈ closedBall z₀ ρ, z ≠ z₀ → f z = r / (z - z₀) + g z) →
        residue f z₀ ρ = r ∧ Tendsto (fun z => (z - z₀) * f z) (𝓝[≠] z₀) (𝓝 r)

universal.type: ∀ z ∈ closedBall z₀ ρ, z ≠ z₀ → f z = r / (z - z₀) + g z
universal.name: hf
